plugins\/airwell\/core\/class\/AirwellDi.Le climatiseur a changé d'adresse IP : i: The air conditioner's IP address has changed: it is now %s. Update the IP, save, then run the binding again. To prevent this, reserve a fixed IP for the air conditioner in your router (static DHCP lease).
plugins\/airwell\/core\/class\/AirwellDi.L'IP saisie appartient à un autre appare: The IP entered belongs to another device (MAC %s). Check the air conditioner's IP and MAC in your router's interface.
plugins\/airwell\/core\/class\/AirwellDi.Un appareil est bien présent à cette adr: A device is present at this address, but it does not answer the local Gree protocol (UDP port 7000). Check that no firewall blocks this port. Some recent Wi-Fi modules only allow cloud control.
plugins\/airwell\/core\/class\/AirwellDi.Le climatiseur n'est pas sur le même rés: The air conditioner is not on the same network as Jeedom and does not answer. Put them on the same network (same router, no guest network or separate VLAN), or check the IP entered.
plugins\/airwell\/core\/class\/AirwellDi.Aucun appareil ne répond à cette IP. Vér: No device answers at this IP. Check the air conditioner's current IP in your router, that it is powered and connected to Wi-Fi, and that Wi-Fi client isolation (guest Wi-Fi, "AP isolation") is disabled.
